title: UMich EECS 498-007 / 598-005: Deep Learning for Computer Vision

unit.title: Engineering a Deterministic Image k-NN Baseline
unit.audience: A strong algorithms student building practical software-engineering skill
learning_objectives: Turn a mathematical nearest-neighbor rule into a small, documented Python component with a stable API.
Specify and enforce shape, type, lifecycle, and non-mutation invariants at module boundaries.
Make neighbor selection, voting, command-line output, and tests deterministic.
Test normal behavior, ties, malformed inputs, and reproducibility without external data or services.
Analyze time and space costs and identify the boundary at which a later vision model can replace the baseline.

required_evidence: Runnable learner implementation matching the public task contract
Passing deterministic learner and harness tests
